NXP-TSMC Research Center, NXP Semiconductors,HTC 4,5656 AE Eindhoven,the Netherlands.
Heat engines provide most of our mechanical power and are essential for transportation on macro-
scopic scale. However, although significant progress has been made in the miniaturization of elec-
trostatic engines, it has proven difficult to reduce the size of liquid or gas driven heat engines below
10"μma.

engine when it is driven by a sufficiently high DC current. A 0.34 μm? engine beam draws heat from
the DC current using the piezoresistive effect and converts it into mechanical work by expansion
and contraction at different temperatures.
